definition: goose is an open-source artificial intelligence agent originally developed by Block.
details: It runs locally as a desktop application or command-line interface and can perform software development and other computer-based tasks using large language models. goose supports models from multiple providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Amazon Bedrock, and OpenRouter, and locally hosted models through Ollama.
story: Think of a chess player who never commits to a move blindly — they consider the board, try an action, watch what changes, and only then decide what is next. Here is the short version: goose is an open-source artificial intelligence agent originally developed by Block. The part that makes it sing: It runs locally as a desktop application or command-line interface and can perform software development and other computer-based tasks using large language models. goose supports models from multiple providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Amazon Bedrock, and OpenRouter, and locally hosted models through Ollama. It is a loop of look, act, and learn — the same way you cook from a recipe you have never tried: add, taste, correct. And that habit of checking, acting, then checking again is Goose (AI agent).
